recentItems.title: All the Best Anime is in Netflix Jail | Get In The Robot
recentItems.description:
If you don't want to be locked in Netflix Jail?  Use ExpressVPN to get beyond those regions locking bars and watch new anime when it comes out on Netflix. Go to https://expressvpn.com/getintherobot and find out how you can get 3 months free.

Please donate to the Okra Project to support! https://www.theokraproject.com

Some of the best anime of the year are locked up in Netflix Jail. Dorohedoro and BNA are the most recent victims of Netflix Jail, and there’s nothing that can stunt the growth of a highly anticipated series like a delayed-release schedule. So let's dive deep into this streaming-age phenomenon.

Don't miss our videos, make sure you subscribe! https://frdr.us/Subscribe

The Digital Age has been great for anime fans, from streaming services like Crunchyroll and Funimation bridging the gap between Japan and the rest of the world when it comes to airing new anime. But there is one that seems to breaks that mold, Netflix. From animes like Beastars, Dorohedoro, BNA, Carol & Tuesday, and more airing in Japan first for 3 to 6 months could hurt a show by the time it reaches outside of Japan. So let's go through what can happen to a show when it gets locked up in Netflix jail.

recentItems.title: These Anime are Trash and I Love Them | Get In The Robot
recentItems.description:
Look, anime is a guilty pleasure to begin with, but some any is just 100% pure high-grade trash. And that’s fine. We all need some trash in our lives. We’ve got some classics like Gintama on our list alongside top-quality trash like Re: Zero. Then there’s Baki… But you know what, this is a love letter to trash. Because we’re trash cans, not trash can’ts!

Don't miss our videos, make sure you subscribe! https://frdr.us/Subscribe

Anime tells amazing stories, introduces us to complicated, interesting characters, and broadens our minds. Then there’s trash anime. And it does those things too! Sometimes. Whether it’s Gintama, Re: Zero, or Baki, you’ll see plenty of beloved anime on this list, because being trash isn’t a bad thing. We LOVE trash.

recentItems.title: If Sailor Moon Characters Had Stands - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Mash-up | Get In The Robot
recentItems.description:
So we’ve given the Jojo’s Bizarre Adventure treatment to MHA and Demon Slayer, but this time we’re giving stands to characters from a Shoujo classic: Sailor Moon. Let’s see what kind of stands the Sailor Senshi manifest!

Don't miss our videos, make sure you subscribe! https://frdr.us/Subscribe

Sailor Moon is a Shoujo classic, in part because of its amazing cast of characters. But what if we mixed things up a bit and gave them Stands of their own? We’re taking notes from Jojo’s Bizarre Adventure and making stands for Usagi (Sailor Moon), Sailor Mars, Sailor Mercury, Tuxedo Mask, Chibi-Usa, and even Luna and Artemis!
